name: Unruled Bereavement receives its discount and damages all allies

rulesClauses: With Mage class bonus after the champion leveled up this turn, Unruled Bereavement costs two less to activate.
At level seven or greater, it deals three damage to every ally.
Until end of turn, each ally death empowers its controller's champion by two.
When Magus Initiate dies to the sweep, its on-death ability draws a card.
